positioning: SkyeMusicNexus is priced for solo artists first. The platform should stay cheap unless a real provider, storage, payout, legal, or hands-on build cost is being created.

foundingCoreMonth.whoItIsFor: Selected May 2026 core artists who help promote, test, and shape the platform.
includes: custom artist landing/universe build at no charge for the May 2026 core-member window
up to 5 launch songs uploaded, packaged into artist surfaces, hosted, and maintained
live drop updates to the artist surface
fan preview plus gated full-song/private-download setup when the artist wants to sell access
0S/FS27 gate signup and SkyeMusicNexus artist node
contractor/onboarding paperwork through the existing shared 0S lanes
upload-failure founder fallback route when configured
exchange: artist tests upload, release, preview, private access, and fan surface flows
artist gives feedback during the founding month
notAutomaticForever: a full SupaBoy-style custom release universe for every later song
unlimited provider-backed storage if R2/CDN/email/provider costs spike
live DSP/distributor, legal, or payout-provider claims before provider proof

artistLandingLaunchWindow.model: Premium listed value stays visible. A $2,000 SkyeMerit applies before checkout so Stripe charges the launch-window due amount.

artistLandingBuilds.name: Single / Drop Landing Page
artistLandingBuilds.scope: one premium artist single/drop landing page from artist info, one main picture, release details, links, and proof fields

artistLandingBuilds.name: Artist Page + Gallery / EPK / Booking / Media
artistLandingBuilds.scope: artist hub with gallery, EPK, booking/media, music/social links, and SkyeMusicNexus dashboard handoff

artistLandingBuilds.name: Animated Landing / Visualizer Page
artistLandingBuilds.scope: animated artist landing and visualizer surface using the artist image, drop metadata, music surfaces, and proof fields

artistLandingBuilds.name: Artist App / PWA Drop Upgrade
artistLandingBuilds.scope: approved artist universe packaged as an installable PWA drop with manifest, service worker, fan share controls, social links, video loops, and Nexus return paths

artistLandingBuilds.name: Custom Artist Universe
artistLandingBuilds.scope: SupaBoy-level custom universe quoted manually above the starting floor

monthlyPlans.bestFor: one solo artist who wants a real platform, upload lane, release packages, preview playback, and fan download/private access surfaces without enterprise pricing
monthlyPlans.notes: Fair-use hosted lane. Provider/storage costs can require owner approval or pass-through if they become material.

monthlyPlans.bestFor: a small group, crew, or tiny indie label with up to 5 active artists
monthlyPlans.notes: Keeps shared release operations, simple approval flow, proof receipts, and collective artist surfaces together.

monthlyPlans.bestFor: artists who want SOL to stay hands-on with rollout, release packaging, content runway, and custom proof
monthlyPlans.notes: Custom full release worlds, advanced provider work, and high-storage/audio pipelines are quoted separately.

pricingRealms.name: Drop Packaging
pricingRealms.summary: Package an existing owned/approved song into a Nexus drop, release page, gated full-file access, store product, proof receipt, and optional campaign kit.
pricingRealms.boundary: Drop packaging does not include AI song generation. It starts after the song or audio file already exists.

pricingRealms.name: Artist Apps
pricingRealms.summary: Turn an artist, song, or project into a public-facing artist page, EPK, visualizer, installable PWA, or custom artist universe.
pricingRealms.boundary: Artist app pricing is based on design/build scope, assets, media, motion, and launch handling.

pricingRealms.name: Song Creation
pricingRealms.summary: Paid AI-assisted song drafting using the MusicNexus provider lane, custom prompts, duration controls, lyrics/vocal direction, receipts, storage, and optional release packaging.
pricingRealms.boundary: The base product is not hardcoded to Gray Skyes or Everything Movie. Buyer prompts, genre, structure, language, mood, collaborators, and length drive the run.

pricingRealms.name: DAW Beta
pricingRealms.summary: First-party browser DAW access for recording, arranging, importing, mixing, saving, and release handoff.
pricingRealms.boundary: DAW access is free for every user through 2026 while it stays labeled beta.

songCreationPricing.name: Song Draft
songCreationPricing.scope: one AI-generated private song draft up to 3 minutes, custom prompt, lyric/vocal direction, provider receipt, private playback, and creation-bin proof
songCreationPricing.notes: Best for testing an idea before paying for artwork, release packaging, store setup, or artist-app treatment.

songCreationPricing.name: Artist Cut
songCreationPricing.scope: one stronger artist-ready song run up to 4 minutes, deeper prompt form, up to 2 generation attempts when provider budget allows, private share page, and basic cover direction
songCreationPricing.packagingIncluded: private share page plus basic release notes

songCreationPricing.name: Release Pack
songCreationPricing.scope: one generated song plus release metadata, cover/canvas request lane, rights checklist, Nexus drop page, product shell, and proof receipt
songCreationPricing.packagingIncluded: drop packaging, store/product shell, and release handoff

songCreationPricing.name: 5-Song Local Artist Bundle
songCreationPricing.scope: five generated song drafts for one artist lane, batch workspace, basic artist profile, creation receipts, and release-package upgrade path
songCreationPricing.packagingIncluded: batch proof and basic artist workspace

songCreationPricing.name: Brain / Label Pack
songCreationPricing.scope: multi-artist or brain/label creation run with roster setup, longer-form structures, collaborator planning, release rooms, social/content workflow, and owner-approved provider budget
songCreationPricing.packagingIncluded: label/brain workspace, release rooms, and campaign workflow

songCreationPricing.name: Cinematic Suite
songCreationPricing.scope: Everything Movie-style long-form suite with multiple acts, longer runtime, cast/collaborator planning, transitions, release page, Pics2Vid/Still2Vid handoffs, and advanced packaging
songCreationPricing.packagingIncluded: multi-act release packaging and app handoffs
songCreationPricing.reference: Everything Movie used 4 acts, 12 total generated minutes, 16 artist appearances, four drop rooms, a collective release page, and per-act creation receipts.

dropPricing.name: Single Song Drop
dropPricing.scope: one existing song release capsule, preview/full package settings, metadata checklist, gated handoff, and proof receipt

dropPricing.name: Release Drop Plus
dropPricing.scope: existing single or multi-track release prep with cover/metadata QA, ops queue, preview/full package settings, and proof export

dropPricing.name: EP Drop
dropPricing.scope: release capsule and proof workflow for up to 6 existing tracks

dropPricing.name: Album Drop
dropPricing.scope: release capsule and proof workflow for up to 14 existing tracks

dropPricing.name: Release Content Kit
dropPricing.scope: captions, short-form hooks, asset requests, and release runway tasks

dropPricing.name: Community Campaign Sprint
dropPricing.scope: community prompts, inbox coordination, content runway, and proof receipt

dawBetaAccess.name: DAW Beta
dawBetaAccess.scope: browser DAW access for every user during the 2026 beta window
dawBetaAccess.claimBoundary: Keep the DAW labeled beta. It is a first-party creation and release-handoff surface, not a finished Pro Tools, Ableton, or BandLab replacement.

fanPaidAccess.fullSongDelivery: Use a gated stream route, signed R2/SkyeVault URL, or private package download. Do not call an unlisted static file private.
fanPaidAccess.buyerExperience: Fan hears/sees a preview first, pays the artist-set fee, then receives gated access to the full song/package.
fanPaidAccess.platformBoundary: SkyeMusicNexus records proof, access, and payout-review state. Real payment settlement requires the configured payment/provider lane and owner approval.

providerCostRule: Do not overcharge solo artists for normal platform use. Charge or pass through only when a provider cost is real: R2/CDN storage growth, email attachment fallback, payment processing, live distributor/DSP work, legal review, royalty settlement, or hands-on custom build labor.
proofBoundary: Gate session is required for every artist/admin/workflow surface.
Artists retain ownership of their catalog.
Preview playback requires ownership and preview-use attestation.
Release publish, stream reporting, and operations queueing require rights readiness.
Formal legal advice, live DSP delivery, real-money payout settlement, and licensed catalog streaming are not claimed until connected and proven.

fanCommerceAndPayouts.checkoutTrail: SkyePay/Stripe checkout should carry hashed artist ID, drop ID, SKU, fee policy, Stripe IDs, fulfillment route, and payout batch state.
fanCommerceAndPayouts.companyFee: 13% platform fee by default. Artist chooses whether the fan covers it on top or it is absorbed from artist payout.
fanCommerceAndPayouts.payoutCadence: Biweekly payout review after paperwork, rights, refunds, disputes, provider costs, and owner approval.
fanCommerceAndPayouts.legalLanes: Vendor/seller paperwork covers fan revenue. Independent contractor paperwork covers company-paid services. Some artists can complete both.
fanCommerceAndPayouts.businessFeatureDiscount: Eligible Nexus artists can receive a 67% discount on greater 0S business features when approved.
